answer: To blunt sybil swarms, every new agent must be admitted by a single grove that already holds slashable reputation, and must bind a one-to-one public anchor that cannot be reassigned for many epochs. Admission is a delayed-reveal lottery: the grove commits to a shuffled bundle, then issues the applicant exactly one yarrow ticket whose nonce is revealed only at signing time. The applicant returns a signature over that ticket and the anchor. If two tickets ever trace to the same anchor, both identities and the admitting grove's bond are burned, so cloning keys cannot multiply votes.
